item.description:
Formula 0.1.86

  • Ideas: a minute offline no longer throws away a cloud build that is still running (#166)
  • Support: articles worth writing, bug reports for engineering, clinics at risk, subjects on the rise, and who on the team settled it before (#165)
  • Support: promises set their own reminders, quiet customers get a check-in, handovers leave a note, and several customers reporting one thing become one fix (#164)
  • Support: the co-pilot waits out a usage limit, and uses a second Claude account, instead of giving up on conversations (#163)
  • Support: a second reader checks every drafted reply, loose facts are flagged, unsure looks try again, and customers are answered in their own language (#161)
  • Support: a conversation that became an idea is linked to the idea's pull requests, so the customer is told when it ships (#162)
